note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 1 June 1933 in Glenshesk only. Nominations closed on Wednesday 10 May 1933 (Ballymoney Free Press, 11 May 1933, p. 2). Printed 'Glenmakeerin'. Sole nominee (Ballymoney Free Press, 11 May 1933, p. 2: the only contest in the district was Glenshesk). Returned unopposed.
